import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { currentRelations } from "./current_relations";

// Introspected as an owned-child: belongs to current_relations (its only foreign key inside the primary key) and nothing else references it.
// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "member_role" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const currentRelationMembers = defineTable("current_relation_members", {
    columns: {
        relationId: col.bigint().primaryKey(),
        memberType: col.enum(["Node", "Way", "Relation"], { name: "nwr_enum" }).notNull(),
        memberId: col.bigint().notNull(),
        memberRole: col.text().notNull(),
        sequenceId: col.integer().primaryKey().default(0)
    },
    relations: {
        relation: rel.belongsTo(() => currentRelations, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
